AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: Chandelier.cs:23-34 gains EnergyVar(3).BaseValue when the owner is among the participants and PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber == 3; chandelier.py:19-21 is the same branch with the same constant. Same slot argument as the sibling relic/candelabra, executed via `py audit/tools/relic_probes.py turn-order`: on_player_turn_started is the post-draw slot that audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json step 23 assigns to AfterSideTurnStart, i.e. after the energy reset at step 17, so the +3 survives.

guards.rationale: The `player != base.Owner` / `card.Owner != base.Owner` / `participants.Contains(base.Owner.Creature)` family is the multiplayer per-player filter on a hook the game dispatches for every player (and, for the participants form, also admits pets). The sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one PlayerCombatState) and models no pet creature, so the filter is structurally satisfied. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract.

Same mechanism and same verdict as relic/candelabra N2 and relic/captains_wheel N2 (binding rule 3): audit/records/seam/turn_structure.json's extra-turn step establishes that self.turn models PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber, and lists the ported turn-number readers it checked.

Identical to relic/candelabra N3 -- EnergyCmd.gain (cmds.py:547-553) runs modify_energy_gain like PlayerCmd.GainEnergy runs Hook.ModifyEnergyGain; the only dropped leg is the AfterModifyingEnergyGain companion event, which belongs to the hook layer. Contrast relic/booming_conch, whose direct assignment skips the chain entirely and is a recorded gap.

guards.what: N4: `EnergyVar(3)` and the unused `private const int _energyTurn = 3` (Chandelier.cs:15, 19)
guards.rationale: Turn index and energy amount are both 3 here, as they were both 2 in Candelabra -- the same coincidence, checked the same way. The const is dead in the decompiled source; line 27's literal 3 is the turn test and DynamicVars.Energy is the amount. The sim's single literal 3 serves the amount and its `self.turn == 3` the index. No AscensionHelper call in the file.

guards.what: N5: `InvokeDisplayAmountChanged()` (Chandelier.cs:32), which fires on EVERY turn the owner participates in, not only turn 3, plus Flash() and ExtraHoverTips (lines 21, 29)
guards.rationale: RelicModel.Flash() / FlashSfx / base.Status / ShowCounter / DisplayAmount / InvokeDisplayAmountChanged / CanonicalVars / ExtraHoverTips / Cmd.Wait / CardCmd.Preview are presentation only -- the relic bar's glow, counter, sfx and hover text, and animation timing. The sim has no relic UI. Waived under the shared contract's presentation/animation exclusion, not under an unreachability claim. Worth naming explicitly because it is the one structural difference between Chandelier and Candelabra: Chandelier's hook body does something on every turn, and that something is a UI refresh notification with no model effect.
